user_input: How does the Red Sea shipping crisis affect EU automotive supply chains?
retrieved_contexts: Houthi attacks in the Red Sea have forced major carriers (Maersk, MSC) to reroute around the Cape of Good Hope, adding 10-14 days to Asia-Europe transit.
European automotive plants run lean just-in-time inventory; component lead times from Asia have extended from 30 to 45 days.
response: The Red Sea crisis reroutes Asia-Europe container traffic around Africa, adding 10-14 days transit. EU automotive plants on just-in-time inventory face component lead times stretching from 30 to roughly 45 days, raising stockout risk for Tier 1 suppliers.
reference: Rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope adds 10-14 days to Asia-Europe shipping, extending automotive component lead times from about 30 to 45 days and stressing just-in-time inventories.

user_input: What is the disruption risk to Taiwanese semiconductor suppliers during typhoon season?
retrieved_contexts: Pacific typhoon season (Jun-Nov) brings peak storm activity to Taiwan, where major semiconductor fabs are concentrated around Hsinchu.
Fabs maintain backup power and water, but port closures at Kaohsiung can delay outbound chip shipments by several days.
response: During the June-November Pacific typhoon season, Taiwanese fabs near Hsinchu face elevated weather risk. While fabs have backup utilities, Kaohsiung port closures can delay outbound chip shipments by several days, creating short-window logistics disruption.
reference: Typhoon season (Jun-Nov) threatens Taiwanese fabs mainly through port closures at Kaohsiung that delay chip shipments by days, though fabs maintain backup power and water.

user_input: How does the Panama Canal drought impact transit times?
retrieved_contexts: Low water levels at the Panama Canal have cut daily transit slots and draft limits, forcing some carriers to reroute or wait in queue.
Reduced slots increase Asia-US East Coast transit variability and spot freight costs.
response: Drought-driven low water at the Panama Canal reduces daily transit slots and draft limits, lengthening Asia-US East Coast transit and raising spot freight costs as carriers queue or reroute.
reference: Panama Canal drought reduces transit slots and draft limits, increasing Asia-US East Coast transit times and spot freight costs.

user_input: Did a fire destroy 80% of global chip capacity last week?
retrieved_contexts: A minor fire was reported at a single packaging facility; the operator stated production was unaffected and no capacity was lost.
response: A catastrophic fire destroyed 80% of global semiconductor capacity last week, causing a 6-month worldwide chip shortage and tripling prices.
reference: A minor fire occurred at one packaging facility with no production impact or capacity loss; claims of an 80% global capacity loss are false.
